Title: Verify that a shop owner can retrieve their own dashboard summary without providing shopId explicitly
Preconditions: User is authenticated as a shop owner with a valid JWT token and has at least one shop bound to their account
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/summary with the Authorization header containing the JWT token of the shop owner.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Dashboard summary retrieved successfully", "data": {"totalOrders": <non-null number>, "pendingOrders": <non-null number>, "completedOrders": <non-null number>, "totalRevenue": <non-null number>}}

Title: Verify that a shop owner can retrieve customers for their own shop without providing shopId explicitly
